answer: Yes, there are several things to raise. The most important is your stool test (FIT) from 4 November 2025, which came back positive. Your records don't show a follow-up colonoscopy or any other follow-up of that result, so please ask about it first. Second, your LDL cholesterol was 131 mg/dL in February 2025, and you started atorvastatin two days later. There is no cholesterol test in your records since then, so a recheck looks overdue. Third, your last HbA1c was 6.9% in February 2026. With type 2 diabetes it should be checked every 3 to 6 months, so another one is due. Also, your records show metformin ended in April 2024 with no reason recorded, and no diabetes medicine is recorded until Jardiance in February 2025. Your HbA1c rose from 7.4% to 8.3% during that gap, so it is worth asking whether that was intended. Other things I could not find: a urine albumin test (it checks for early kidney damage from diabetes; your eGFR was 69 in February 2026), any diabetic eye exam or foot exam, and any vaccines. These may exist somewhere else, so it is worth checking. One thing that does add up: the blood clot scare in July 2025 was ruled out by a CT scan that showed no pulmonary embolism.
short: Positive stool test (FIT) from November 2025 with no follow-up colonoscopy in my records; LDL 131 in February 2025 with no recheck since starting atorvastatin; last HbA1c 6.9% in February 2026 is due for repeat; metformin stopped April 2024 with no recorded replacement until February 2025, and no urine albumin, eye, foot or vaccine records.
